path_scope: Relative to a selected physical volume; native mount paths never enter Guest ABI

user_flow.volume_selection: Native Host confirmation; updates retain their existing volume

authority.installation: Device-authenticated mirrored local records plus full publisher/code verification
authority.cache: Volume-bound authenticated completion descriptor, never execution authority
authority.platform_device_secret: ESP implementation retains one fixed device secret in NVS; legacy app adapter is separate
authority.resources: Exact publisher-signed resource manifest, all logical file digests and application record media-volume binding

admission.install: Refresh, geometry-aware peak accounting, reserve selected mount, exact manifest approval and previous record CAS
admission.offline_download: Cache footprint only; installation admission evaluated separately

supported_host_topologies: multiple registered partitions on one flash
no primary file partition with board-provided external volume
pending: legacy whole-app and implicit manual-media migration
system-font mount lifetime and hotplug recovery

transfer.entry: Native Host only; idle unarchived volume-local application, explicit target volume
transfer.confirmation: Settings app detail; no-write/no-reservation preview, exact source record and mount instance rechecked on commit; system-owned progress UI on the existing runtime task
transfer.identity: Preserve InstallID, data generation, code and resource digests; install generation N -> N+1
transfer.receipt: PXMT canonical state inside device-authenticated PXMS dual slots; bind physical volume, endpoint role and publisher/App locator
transfer.visibility: Quarantine target while any transfer slot or pending slot exists, including damaged receipts
transfer.private_data: Bounded PSRAM walker, no symlinks, full destination SHA reread; authenticate and reseal permissions/directory grants
transfer.handoff: Durable source-home retirement and target-local surrender proof precede target record commit
transfer.retry: Rebuild uncommitted private snapshot from idle source; after surrender require prepared private state and never format it
transfer.offline: Source missing before proof stays pending; authenticated proof permits finishing an already prepared target
transfer.slot_replace: Retain an authenticated durable peer; no-replace filesystems retire only the replaceable slot before publishing its synced temporary
transfer.startup: Discover target-local receipts on registered ready volumes and resume before queued launches; keep offline or invalid transfers quarantined; reuse runtime task stack

resource_transfer.entry: Native Settings confirmation for an idle volume-local app with publisher-signed resources
resource_transfer.commit: Prepare or fully verify the identical target generation, then compare the complete approved app record and mirror its new resource binding
resource_transfer.preserved: App volume, code, InstallID, data generation and permissions; increment installation generation only
resource_transfer.source: Retain immutable original until ownership-aware garbage collection is available

store.metadata: Verify both signed metadata before confirmation and transfers
store.admission: Atomic selected-volume reservation, shared-volume phased peak accounting

publisher_directory.preferred: Verified signer profile handle; stable after first allocation
publisher_directory.collision: Append and extend signing-root fingerprint; never take over an occupied directory
publisher_directory.binding: Volume-local .publisher.pxi authenticates volume, purpose, full signing root and name
publisher_directory.logical_locator: Full publisher_root_hex/app_id remains the install-record authentication binding
publisher_directory.migration: Marker commit before atomic rename; existing shared media renamed only during cold startup
